name: PaletteFrostvine
intent: A frost-killed vineyard of dark plum-brown terraces and near-black dead vines below a broken violet-slate manor, marked by a pale cool road, one deep muted wine-purple accent, frost-grey mist and a single amber lamp.

critic_pass1.why: Plum-brown ground under a violet-slate far land is unlike anything else in the run, but the grey-violet road sits close in value to the plum ground at eye level.
critic_pass1.fix: road cobblestone about 12 values lighter and a touch cooler so it parts from the plum walk ground at eye level

critic_pass2.why: The road moved from a purple-grey that sank into the plum ground to a neutral pale grey that now reads clearly from both cameras, though the plum-slate whole still sits near Rimeholt's cool cast.
